title: reference-coverage: verifiable coverage of DNA barcode reference libraries in climate space
description: A workflow for measuring how much of the geographic and climatic range in which a taxon is recorded is backed by reference sequences whose species label can be verified against a morphologically identified specimen, and for ranking the places where a new reference specimen would add the most. Spider mites (Acari: Tetranychidae) are the demonstration taxon; every script takes a taxon name as an argument.
